topic: ai overviews: google says no special ai seo is needed, same search basics
hook: Paying for AI SEO? Google says you don't need it. Here's their exact rule.
caption:
Comment LEARN and I'll send you my free SEO starter guide. Google AI Overviews and AI SEO, explained for contractors.

Agencies in Dallas, Miami and Phoenix are pitching AI SEO this fall. Sounds expensive.

Google's own Search Central page on AI features says there are no extra requirements and no special optimization needed. To be one of the links in an AI Overview, your page has to be indexed and allowed to show a snippet. That's it. Two boxes.

So the same 3 basics still win for a roofer in Austin: a clear page title, real content about your service and city, a fast site on an iPhone.

#seo #webdesign #seotips #websitetips #seoforbeginners
